description: This file implements the CallsignTLS class methods related to thread-local storage of callsign information within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It provides functions to get and set the callsign associated with the current thread, conditioned on specific compile-time flags.

classes.name: CallsignTLS
classes.description: A class managing thread-local storage of callsign information within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

methods.name: CallsignTLS::Callsign()
methods.description: Retrieves the callsign associated with the current thread, if set, otherwise returns nullptr.

methods.name: CallsignTLS::Callsign(const char*)
methods.description: Sets the callsign for the current thread's thread-local storage.
